Docs.summary: Calculates the four-byte CRC-32 used by ITU-T V.42 and IEEE 802.3.
Docs.remarks: Byte results use little-endian order. CRC-32 has incompatible variants; this implementation does not use the CRC defined by ITU-T I.363.5. If this implementation's CRC bytes follow the original message, the CRC of the combined input is the fixed byte sequence 1C DF 44 21.
